text:
Riley (Product): shared a new compact heatmap + p95 card in Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE - need quick input on legend wording, scrubber keyboard behavior, and sampling control location.

Tess (Design): current mock uses a stacked legend with 5 bins; suggestion: reduce to 4 for clarity, and add a concise label: "Density (darker = more requests)". also prefer a right-side mini-panel on desktop so the scrubber remains unobstructed.

Arun (Frontend): right-side mini-panel is good. on small viewports switch to a full-width bottom sheet. ensure the panel doesn't steal focus on hover-only reveal; open on focus/click for keyboard users.

Marta (Backend): we can include per-bucket sample_count and a sample_confidence flag. if sample_count < 10 we can surface a tiny warning: "insufficient samples". cheap to add to the series API.

Tess (Design): microcopy proposal for hover: "p95: 280 ms 3 x n=720" - jk, better: "p95: 280 ms  n=720". keep it one line. add a small "View traces" link.

Riley (Product): prefer "p95: 280 ms  n=720 • View traces" - short and scannable.

doc-bot: recommended docs link: /docs/observability/latency-cards#sampling - include examples of sample-rate tradeoffs.

a11y-bot: checklist: ensure scrubber thumb >=44x44px; Left/Right arrow moves to previous/next bucket and announces "time: 12:34, p95 280 ms" via aria-live; Enter/Space opens panel, Esc closes and returns focus. panel should have role=dialog and aria-modal=false.

Arun (Frontend): implementation note: client should snap scrubber to timestamps returned by API buckets. debounce keyboard scrubbing to 150ms to avoid flooding trace queries. also lazy-load detailed metrics for the panel after first open.

Tess (Design): accessibility nit: increase focus ring to 3px and use a high-contrast color. legend squares need sr-only labels like "low, medium, high, very high". on mobile show 3 bins, desktop 4.

Marta (Backend): will add sample_count and bucket_timestamps. we'll also tag low-confidence buckets so frontend can gray them out.

Riley (Product): decisions: right mini-panel desktop + bottom sheet mobile, per-card sampling override under gear menu with org default fallback, short hover microcopy, colorblind-safe palette (Viridis), show sample counts and an "insufficient samples" hint. Tess update mocks, Arun/Marta to prototype and run a11y checklist.

Arun (Frontend): will prototype keyboard interactions and post demo link.

Tess (Design): updated Figma pushed and left a comment with the new legend options.

Riley (Product): thanks all  closing thread and consolidating notes into the spec.
